sourceProvenance.title: Minha Machadinha
sourceProvenance.edition: Traditional melody documented as Schindler-956 in Porto in the CSIC source collection dated 1932; complete familiar Brazilian form independently notated and cross-checked against the Beatriz Kauffmann folklore reference; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (traditional musical work); third-party reference files are not redistributed
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

sourceReference.redistribution: not bundled; retained as an external historical research reference

crossCheckReferences.provider: Beatriz Kauffmann - Musicas do Folclore Brasileiro
crossCheckReferences.role: Brazilian form and lyric-order cross-check only; the third-party MIDI is not bundled

derivation.melody: independent Pianify notation of the public-domain Brazilian traditional form; historical incipit and interval contour verified in the CSIC catalog; no third-party MIDI is bundled
derivation.harmony: Pianify editorial piano harmonization v1, clearly separated from the traditional melody
